title: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition proves popular despite price
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick reveals that many players pre-ordering GTA 6 are opting for the expensive Ultimate edition over the standard version.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Pre-orders: High-End Editions Take the Lead

The pricing strategy of next-generation blockbuster games continues to be a major talking point in the gaming industry. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, Strauss Zelnick, CEO of Rockstar Games' parent company Take-Two, has shed light on consumer behavior regarding the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6.

### Pricing Tiers and Consumer Choices

While the baseline Standard edition of GTA 6 is priced at $80 (£70), and the more comprehensive Ultimate edition reaches $100 (£90), many might initially expect gamers to shy away from the triple-digit price tag. However, Zelnick revealed that a substantial portion of consumers placing pre-orders are actually bypassing the standard option in favor of the higher-priced Ultimate edition.

This trend highlights a fascinating shift in how dedicated fans approach major franchise releases. Instead of opting for the budget-friendly path, a massive wave of players is willing to invest the extra cash to secure the premium package right out of the gate.

### Industry Implications

Such strong early uptake for the $100 tier underscores the immense pulling power of the GTA brand. Rockstar Games has cultivated a loyal community over the past decade, and these pre-order numbers suggest that consumer enthusiasm heavily outweighs financial hesitation for the series' most devoted followers. As the industry watches closely, this phenomenon could very well set a new benchmark for how premium editions perform in the modern gaming landscape.

## Editor's Take

GTA 6 continues to defy standard market anxieties. The willingness of fans to snap up the $100 Ultimate edition shows that when it comes to Rockstar's crown jewel, price resistance is much lower for dedicated players than many might assume. It is a powerful testament to the studio's unmatched market influence.
